widgets_values: Maintain strong reference consistency. Do not change the face, hairstyle, clothing, colors, accessories, body proportions, or overall style of Reference Image 1 and Reference Image 2. Do not change the identity, proportions, wrapped-leaf appearance, facial features, and cute mascot style of Reference Image 3. Do not change the shape, material, glowing veins, and symbolic role of the magical bamboo leaf in Reference Image 4. Do not change the lighting, structure, festive decorations, and bright Dragon Boat Festival atmosphere of Reference Image 5. Reference Image 1 is a young ancient Chinese man with a gentle and refined face, long black hair half tied back, wearing layered pale cyan, white, and light blue hanfu robes, holding fresh bamboo leaves and a small bag of glutinous rice, with a calm, sincere, slightly unconfident temperament. Reference Image 2 is a young ancient Chinese woman with a sweet and gentle face, long black hair half-up with light green floral ornaments and tassels, wearing a pale green, cream, and light gold hanfu dress with soft flowing sleeves, holding prepared bamboo leaves and wrapping strings, with a warm, graceful, encouraging temperament. Reference Image 3 is a cute zongzi spirit mascot, shaped like a round triangular rice dumpling wrapped in bright green leaves and tied with pale strings, with a soft cream-colored face, big bright eyes, tiny hands and feet, and an energetic, cheerful expression. Reference Image 4 is a magical glowing bamboo leaf, fresh green with soft golden glowing veins, carrying gentle festive spiritual energy, and functioning as the key symbolic prop of the story. Reference Image 5 is a bright and warm Dragon Boat Festival market stall in an ancient town, with neat wooden tables, baskets of glutinous rice, stacks of bamboo leaves, finished zongzi, hanging mugwort, calamus, sachets, colorful cords, and a few lanterns, under sunny and festive lighting. Create a 15-second one-take Dragon Boat Festival fantasy scene with a bright, positive, heartwarming tone and smooth pacing. No running, no large plot jumps, no dark horror mood, and no chaotic action. At the beginning, the young man stands at the stall, looking at the bamboo leaves and rice in his hands with a slightly worried expression, while the young woman stands beside him, watching gently. The camera starts with a medium two-shot. In the first 5 seconds, the man says softly in Chinese: “我怕我包不好，浪费了这么好的粽叶。” The woman smiles and replies in Chinese: “粽叶不会挑最会包的人，它只会挑最有心意的人。” As she speaks, the small zongzi spirit peeks out from beside the bamboo leaves on the table and looks at the man curiously. In the middle 5 seconds, the glowing bamboo leaf slowly lights up with warm golden veins and floats lightly toward the man’s hands. The zongzi spirit bounces once in encouragement. The woman gently nods toward him. The man takes a breath, relaxes, and begins to wrap a zongzi carefully. His hands are a little clumsy at first, but he becomes steadier. In the final 5 seconds, the man successfully finishes a simple but sincere zongzi. The small zongzi spirit happily claps its tiny hands. The woman looks at the finished zongzi and says softly in Chinese: “你看，这样就已经是一个很好的粽子了。” The man smiles with relief and quiet pride, then says in Chinese: “原来有心意，比包得完美更重要。” The camera slowly pushes in and ends on a warm medium shot of the two characters, the completed zongzi, and the glowing bamboo leaf on the festive stall. Add subtle motion details: soft sleeve movement, light hair movement, gentle cloth and leaf motion, warm sunlight, faint glow from the magical leaf, tiny natural movement from the mascot, and a calm festive atmosphere. Bright, clean, warm, slightly magical, positive, elegant ancient Chinese fantasy style, high quality, stable character consistency.
